objective: Author Profession, Background, Culture, Faction and other social/identity packages plus Species, Form, Archetype, Template, Variant and Trait definition composition with explicit inheritance, reference, compatibility and scoped-override behavior while preserving live Character and relationship ownership.
acceptance: social package authoring cannot mutate live relationships
Species/Form/Template definitions remain distinct from live Characters
boundaries: MRCS-01/03/04/05 remain the workspace, guided authoring, bounded-expression and mechanical-definition foundations consumed by this tranche.

Profession, Background, Culture, Faction and social package definitions remain definition-layer content; relationship, reputation, standing and live social state remain external owner-domain authority.
Species, Form, Archetype, Template, Variant and Trait records remain definitions/packages distinct from live Character identity, body, form or progression state.
Inheritance and scoped override conflicts must remain explicit diagnostics requiring authored resolution; MRCS cannot silently choose a winner.
Unknown compatibility, owner data and source semantics remain unresolved rather than inferred or defaulted compatible/incompatible.
Package composition may reference governed mechanical definitions and expressions but cannot execute them or mutate runtime state.
MRCS-11+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
MSAS and MVPS lane state remains independent.
